title: zlrx.2: Wire save_recipient calls after successful OSCORE unprotect in lichen-gateway
description: Same as zlrx.1 but for lichen-gateway. The gateway has its own GatewayOscoreSenderStore (now implements ContextStateStore with TODO stubs for load_recipient/save_recipient). Wire actual persistence: either extend the existing sealed-record machinery or delegate to the GatewayOscoreRecipientStore (which already persists a simpler single-window replay state). Reconcile the two RecipientReplayState structs (gateway's local 3-field vs oscore's 11-field).
